name: Checklist_Templates
label: Checklist Templates
_about: QC-R1 (03 Fulfillment / 03 Pick, QC, Rework and Crate): 'checklist per item category, stored as a template so categories can have different checks.' Matches the real target schema (08 Design Doc / 01 Database, checklist_templates: kind, item_category, lines). Admin-editable, same pattern as Suggested_Actions -- no custom widget, edited directly. A row here NARROWS which of the mandatory QC-R2 checklist groups apply to that category; a category with NO row here still requires every group, exactly like today, before any template exists for it. Kind is 'qc' for every row today (crate/vehicle templates are not built -- only the QC groups are mandatory-checked anywhere in this codebase).

fields.name: Kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.helpText: qc, crate or vehicle (only qc is read anywhere today).

fields.name: Item_Category
fields.label: Item category
fields.helpText: Must match an Items.category value exactly.

fields.name: Lines
fields.label: Required checklist groups
fields.helpText: Which QC-R2 groups this category must have ticked to be Approved. Leave empty to require none of them (not the same as no row at all, which requires every group).
